notes: Cold start, 524 GB paging from SSD. Correct output.
Warm but still slow — expert files not cached. Repetition from greedy + INT4 quantization noise.
f16 inline conversion adds to critical path. f32 double-buffer hides conversion behind FFN. SIMD fix (convert_to_f32_slice) kept as infra.

lm_head=19ms (2.9% of total). cblas_sgemv already saturates M4 Max bandwidth single-threaded. Also tried sgemv_f16_par (1.41, rayon alloc overhead) and sgemv_f16 (1.38, FCVTL < DRAM bandwidth). All reverted.

Pool write-back caused 3x regression (0.49 tok/s): 23MB alloc+copy per miss × 480/token = 11GB alloc churn + page cache eviction. Disabled write-back; OS page cache handles expert caching. Profiling: MLA=2.2ms/layer FFN=9.0ms/layer convert_wait≈0.

Pool tracking (HashMap request()) is dead overhead when write-back disabled. Changed default pool_cap from 3000→0 (pool=None). Saves ~0.3ms/layer of HashMap lookups but within noise. RUSTANE_POOL_CAP env var re-enables.

Split pread into gate+up (overlaps shared_ffn) + down (overlaps GPU fused). REVERTED: pread_dn(1.5-2.5ms) > GPU fused(~1.75ms), no overlap benefit. Extra cmd buffer overhead. Profiling: pread_gu=2-3ms shared_ffn=2.3-4ms Metal=3.7-4ms. Kept: const u32 buffer caching.

Cached u32 constant Metal buffers (hidden/moe_inter/group_size) in MetalDequantGemv struct, eliminating ~360 newBufferWithBytes per token. Overhead was ~0.18ms/token (180 × 4-byte allocs). Committed as code cleanup — cleaner than per-dispatch HashMaps.

Parallelized 64 per-head W_UK absorption + W_UV projection sgemv calls with rayon par_chunks_mut. Synthetic test: 315µs→286µs (1.10x). Real decode: within noise (-3.8%). Per-head sgemv on [128,512] is only ~5µs/call — 64 calls = 320µs/layer, rayon overhead (~15µs) negates gains. Fixed pre-existing build error (removed dead f16 fields from make_attn_weights).

Replaced std::thread::scope with rayon::join for pread+shared_ffn overlap in moe_ffn_v2. Hypothesis: eliminate ~60 pthread_create/join per token. Result: -2.5%, within noise. Nested par_iter inside rayon::join causes work-stealing contention — rayon steals pread tasks onto shared_ffn's thread, serializing them. REVERTED.

CRITICAL: fused_gate_up_silu shader had x_cache[4096] but K2 in_features=7168 — cols 4096-7167 used OOB threadgroup memory (garbage/zeros). Fixed to half x_cache[7168] (14KB, fits 32KB TG limit). Output changed from degenerate repetition ("a transformer, a transformer is a transformer") to correct ("a static electrical device which works on the principle of electromagnetic induction"). Previous 1.57* was inflated — repetitive output routes same experts (cache warm). Correct model uses diverse experts → more pread misses → true speed. NEW BASELINE: 1.15 tok/s.

V2 down shader x_cache from float[4096] (16KB) to half[4096] (8KB). No improvement — down pass with in_features=2048 is bandwidth-bound, not occupancy-limited. float[4096]=16KB already allows 2 concurrent TGs. REVERTED.

fcntl(F_RDADVISE) hint before pread for each expert. No improvement — pread itself triggers DMA immediately, window between hint and read is microseconds. 8 extra fcntl syscalls add ~10µs overhead. REVERTED.

Split pread into gate+up (phase 1, overlaps shared_ffn) + down (phase 3, overlaps Metal fused via 2 cmd bufs). dispatch_fused_phase returns PendingGpuWork, pread_dn runs during GPU fused, then dispatch_down_phase. Profiling: pread_dn (1-2ms) ≈ Metal_fused (1.75ms) so overlap window ≈ 0. Extra cmd buf overhead ~0.1ms × 60 layers = 6ms. Correctness test confirms bit-identical split vs single. REVERTED.

Changed fused_gate_up_silu and dequant_4bit_gemv_v2 shaders from TG=256/ROWS_PER_TG=8 to TG=512/ROWS_PER_TG=16. THREADS_PER_ROW=32 preserved. Updated all 5 Rust dispatch sites. Correctness verified (max_diff=0.004). Result: -8.7% regression (1.05 vs 1.15). Larger TGs likely reduce GPU occupancy — M4 Max has 40 EUs, fewer concurrent TGs per EU with 512-thread groups. REVERTED.

Used sgemv_f16_par to read o_proj directly as f16 from backbone mmap (118 MB vs 235 MB f32). Added o_proj_f16 field to MlaLayerWeights, conditional dispatch in mla_forward_decode. Correctness perfect (max_diff=4.84e-8). -21% REGRESSION. Root cause: double-buffer pipeline already pre-converts o_proj f16→f32 overlapped with prior layer's FFN — the f32 data is warm in DRAM. f16_par bypasses this, reading cold mmap pages during MLA, competing with expert pread for page cache. Same lesson as iter 1: f16 on critical path loses to pre-staged f32.

fcntl(F_NOCACHE, 1) on expert file fds in ExpertLoader::open(). Bypasses OS page cache for expert pread → direct SSD-to-user-buffer DMA. +46% improvement. Root cause: expert pread pollutes page cache with 176 MB/layer (10 GB/token) of rarely-reused data, evicting shared FFN weights from DRAM. F_NOCACHE eliminates this: shared_ffn drops from 2.4-4.4ms to 1.5-2.7ms (less bandwidth contention), and pread direct DMA avoids memcpy overhead. NVMe SSD controller DRAM cache (1-4 GB) handles frequently-accessed experts instead of OS page cache. Cold decode slightly slower (0.67 vs 0.93) as expected — no page cache warming.

Removed threadgroup x_cache from fused_gate_up_silu and dequant_4bit_gemv_v2 shaders. x now read directly from device memory (L2-cached). Speed +1.8% (within noise). CORRECTNESS: max_diff 0.088→0.000488 (180x better) — f32 x reads replace f16 x_cache truncation. Code quality: removes hardcoded x_cache[7168] (prev OOB bug source), eliminates threadgroup barrier. Committed as improvement.

Removed dead mla_layer_weights() calls in run_mla_only and run_layer_compute — result was passed to make_attn_weights which ignored the _f16w parameter (all fields came from f32 source). Eliminated ~30 HashMap lookups + string allocs/token. Also removed unnecessary final_norm.to_vec() (rmsnorm accepts &[f32] directly). *Session baseline 1.34 vs historical 1.68 due to system state variance. Committed as code cleanup.

Split-pread pipeline under F_NOCACHE: pread gate+up (overlaps shared_ffn) → dispatch_fused_phase (non-blocking) → pread down (overlaps GPU fused) → dispatch_down_phase_and_wait. Added load_expert_partial to ExpertLoader, dispatch_fused_phase/dispatch_down_phase_and_wait to MetalDequantGemv. +2.2% within noise. With F_NOCACHE direct DMA, pread is fast enough that pread_dn ≈ Metal_fused (~1.5ms each), overlap window ≈ 0. Extra cmd buffer overhead negates savings. Same conclusion as iter 10 (pre-F_NOCACHE). 3rd attempt at split-pread; dead end confirmed. REVERTED hot path, kept infra. *Session baseline 1.34.

Overlap convert_layer_into with MLA+FFN (instead of FFN-only). convert_wait dropped from 24ms to 0.4ms (23.6ms saved). BUT MLA doubled from 135ms to 270ms (+135ms) due to DRAM bandwidth contention — sgemv competes with conversion for 273 GB/s bandwidth. Net: -9.5% regression. MLA must run without background memory-intensive work. Same lesson as f16 o_proj (iter 12): any concurrent DRAM traffic during MLA degrades sgemv performance.

Pre-cache all 61 layers' MLA weights as f32 at load time (~54 GB). Eliminates double-buffer, thread::scope, convert_wait. Warmup: 3.7s. MLA: 2.1ms/layer (unchanged). FFN: 27ms/layer (4x REGRESSION vs 7ms baseline). Root cause: 54 GB heap allocation evicts backbone mmap pages (shared FFN weights) from page cache → shared_ffn faults from SSD every layer. Same category as pre-F_NOCACHE page cache pollution but in reverse: pinned heap memory starves mmap cache. Memory-hungry optimizations are dead ends on 128 GB system with 524 GB expert files. REVERTED.

Originally IDEA: madvise(MADV_WILLNEED). But madvise loads page cache which F_NOCACHE bypasses — incompatible. Pivoted to speculative pread into separate buffer. Tested 3 variants (see k2-expert-speculation-pread row). All REVERTED: -41% regression. SSD I/O cost exceeds any pread savings. Dead end with F_NOCACHE.

Move o_proj [7168,4096] from CPU cblas_sgemv to Metal F32_GEMV_SHADER (already compiled in dequant.rs). Overlap with next layer convert. Saves ~1.2ms/layer × 61 = ~73ms/token. See: research-context/ane-synthesis.md.

Reshape W_UK [64,128,512] to [8192,512], dispatch as single cblas_sgemm instead of 64 sequential cblas_sgemv. Same for W_UV. Potential 2x faster MLA absorption. rayon parallelism tried (iter 7, NO EFFECT because per-call overhead dominated), but sgemm batching is different — one BLAS call vs 64.

Added RUSTANE_TOP_K env var override. top_k=6 vs 8: +25.5% (0.51→0.64). FFN drops from 1899ms to 1449ms/token (-24%): 2 fewer expert pread (46 MB less I/O) + 2 fewer Metal dispatches per layer × 60 layers. MLA unchanged (133ms). Output quality good: "a transformer is a type of neural network architecture". *Session baseline 0.51 vs historical 1.68 due to system state (Claude Code overhead + SSD controller cache cold). Relative gain consistent across all 3 runs. Opt-in via env var; default behavior unchanged.

Speculative pread: overlap next layer's predicted expert reads with current layer's Metal dispatch. Three implementations tried: (1) thread::scope wrapping Metal — blocked until spec done, adding ~36ms/layer. (2) thread::spawn + sequential pread — same regression, 8×23MB sequential SSD takes ~37ms vs ~3ms overlap window. (3) thread::spawn + parallel pread via inner scope — 8 concurrent NVMe reads still ~5ms, overlap window still ~3ms, join blocks ~2ms/layer minimum. Net result: -41% (0.51→0.30). Root cause: speculative pread adds 184 MB/layer of F_NOCACHE SSD I/O that competes for NVMe bandwidth with normal pipeline. Even with >95% cross-layer routing similarity, the I/O cost exceeds any pread savings. Thread spawn overhead (9600 spawns/decode) and NVMe controller cache thrashing compound the regression. Conclusion: speculation is a dead end with F_NOCACHE — direct DMA is already fast enough that pre-loading doesn't amortize vs the bandwidth cost. *Session baseline 0.51.

Skip ALL routed experts during prefill (shared expert only). Prefill 2.7x faster but output is garbage: "æƘ¯æƘ¯" cold, "aory of the the the" warm. K2 MLA is sensitive on ALL 61 layers — no safe subset to skip. Unlike Qwen3.5 which has 75% delta-net/linear layers.

Keep routed experts every 4th layer + last 4 layers during prefill. 1.9x faster prefill but output repetitive: "capital of France is Paris. is the capital of France." MLA KV cache degrades without routed experts.

Keep routed experts every 2nd layer during prefill. Cold 1.5x faster but warm no improvement. Output borderline: "a type of deep learning architecture". Not reliable enough. MLA needs experts on most layers.

flash-moe's main win: batched projections. Read backbone weights (23.4 GB) once per N-token batch instead of per token. Needs custom Metal kernels: dequant_gemm_4bit_batch, batched MLA attention with online softmax. Architecture change (~500 lines). Expected: 3-6x prefill speedup.

Nearby prefill tokens often route to same experts. Load expert once, process batch of tokens that share it. Reduces SSD reads from N*8*23.4MB to ~8*23.4MB per batch. Needs routing pre-scan + batched Metal dispatch.

Reordered prefill loop: outer=layers, inner=tokens. Backbone weights read once per layer instead of N times. Output identical. 7% cold prefill speedup but negligible warm — with 6-8 tokens, backbone mmap stays in page cache between tokens anyway. Would matter at 200+ tokens. Decode unchanged. REVERTED (complexity not justified for short prompts).
